Legally redistributable device/vendor/kernel trees and firmware licenses reviewed
User backup and verified stock recovery path; no automatic unlock/flash/relock
Verified Boot, SELinux enforcing, encryption and signed OTA/rollback policy
CTS/VTS and applicable CDD/GMS licensing/certification, no Integrity spoofing claims
Native APK build, emulator tests, installer cancellation/failure/signature/ABI/source gates and assistant role tested
Four desktop/Pi v1.2 files and release history remain independent and untouched

daily_experience.catalog_icons: 24 local brand SVGs plus reproducible licensed Android VectorDrawables; real installed icons preferred, bounded generated monograms for unknown packages; no icon CDN.
daily_experience.search: Native HOME: Turkish module/installed-app label/package filtering, accessible profiles; no automatic network search. Bundled/web global search separately covers contacts, notes (16384 chars), tasks, tools, catalog and arithmetic.
daily_experience.home_gestures: Native: six persisted mobile layout families, 2 shortcut pages + 1 widget page, horizontal paging, downward fullscreen controls and upward fullscreen drawer; real system Settings handoff. Web laboratory remains a separate design surface.
daily_experience.phone: Browser: safe tel handoff only. APK: explicit dialer role, CALL_PHONE, native charge/recipient consent -> Telecom/InCallService and in-package controls; actual callback state, never inferred connection. Physical SIM/emergency unverified.
daily_experience.messages: Browser: draft and safe sms handoff. APK: explicit default SMS role/grants/subscription and native consent -> SmsManager, durable multipart receipts and real provider history. queued/sent/delivery distinct; MMS/RCS unsupported.
daily_experience.contacts: APK: explicit READ_CONTACTS, provider change observer and bounded in-memory recipients; separate WRITE_CONTACTS + final confirmation adds a real local contact, never deletes/edits existing contacts. Denied/read/write/cancel/SMS-draft paths passed API35 QEMU. Web laboratory separately stores up to 60 manual local contacts; those are not system contacts.
daily_experience.calendar: 80 local date plans, month navigation; no system calendar, alarm or notification
daily_experience.clock: Timestamp-based persisted stopwatch and timer deadline; no background alarm guarantee
daily_experience.media: Explicit local audio up to 32 MiB; panel volume/mute drives real HTMLMediaElement; page-scoped playback, no upload
daily_experience.photos: 6 explicitly selected temporary images up to 8 MiB each, inspect/download/remove; not permanent library
daily_experience.browser: Explicit safe HTTPS/external search handoff, no embedded web engine
daily_experience.control_center: Fullscreen native surface with real AudioManager media volume, own-window brightness and actual system Settings/panels; app-window immersive mode, not global SystemUI replacement. Browser controls only its preview audio/dimmer.
daily_experience.native_system_delegation: API35/x86_64/4GiB QEMU 24-case acceptance: preserved HOME/inventory/layout/widgets/Phone/SMS/installer/live repository plus six mobile layout families, real system Settings, fullscreen gestures, system contacts/local addition, lock companion, independent native/Python pinned-TLS transfers and fresh-consent MediaProjection. Separate HOME/assistant/Phone/SMS roles; no physical SIM/PC/ARM/GMS/ROM, global SystemUI/keyguard replacement or measured hardware-performance claim.

native_evidence.emulator_acceptance: Same-source 7244164 API35/x86_64/4GiB QEMU PASSED: 24/24 cases in 15 selections, 20 JVM cases, no skipped/empty acceptance, matching independent four-file native/Python pinned-TLS receipts and real MediaProjection cancel/fresh consent/FGS/JPEG/stop verified by the separate CI acceptance gate. Three mandatory review cancel/destruction/original-Home-focus/noninstallation cycles plus final system install passed. No Android product ANR/crash observed in this run, but a 2060ms HWUI main-thread stall was sampled; no permanent ANR fix or hardware-performance claim. No physical SIM/PC/ARM/SystemUI/keyguard/ROM/GMS acceptance.

native_launcher.entry_point: LauncherActivity: MAIN/HOME/LAUNCHER, native Kotlin + Jetpack Compose; not a WebView home.
native_launcher.installed_apps: LauncherApps/UserManager, accessible profile-qualified activities and badged icons; actual search/launch/details. At most 1000 entries, 3MiB icon LRU, background inventory and visible-lifecycle callbacks. No QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.
native_launcher.layout: Six persisted mobile families (oguzdows/kde/gnome/xfce/windows11/mac); 12 default / 16 maximum pins across 2 shortcut pages, explicit add/remove/step-wise move, ordered private IO and corruption write guard; 4 existing wallpapers. Not PC window managers or arbitrary pixel placement.
native_launcher.widgets: Third page: real AppWidgetHost, platform bind/configuration path and RemoteViews, max 2 fixed-size areas. Real fixture binding/content/new-host restoration/removal passed. All-provider/OEM/profile/process-death matrix remains open.
native_launcher.rifki: Local typed deterministic reaction to time/battery/charging/call, pet/head-tilt and left/right placement, explicitly confirmed UI suggestions. No cloud inference, ASR/TTS, microphone, wake word or always-listening animation.
native_launcher.module_handoff: Existing native Phone/SMS/Store and bundled daily modules retained. launcher.home and launcher-origin Back return to native HOME. Shared Phone dark pixels checked, not only a saved theme flag.
native_launcher.visual_scope: Historical accepted 0.3 / fb6cad5 only: actual UiDevice capture reduced to 234x520 JPEG, inspected locally from complete ordered chunks. Not a current 0.4 screenshot. Full current 7244164 PNGs/JPEG are in its artifact; only four of six new thumbnail annotations survived the checks cap, so no new local native image is claimed. Not browser/AI/physical-device imagery.
